defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to fully immune damage in an emergency, or proactively in Mythic+ to take yourself out of the healing pool entirely.

defensives.name: Blessing of Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it on an ally to immune physical damage or strip a physical debuff; avoid using it on the tank unless they ask for it, since it drops their threat.

defensives.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
defensives.usage_rule: Use it often on whoever is taking heavy damage; it transfers their damage to you, so watch your own health, especially on tanks.

defensives.name: Divine Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into predictable incoming damage on yourself; it does not reduce damage transferred to you by your own Blessing of Sacrifice.
